headline: Egypt Real Estate Sales Reach EGP 1.048 Trillion in Nine Months
summary: Egypt's real estate market recorded contractual sales of approximately EGP 1.048 trillion in the first nine months of the year, spanning 64,500 units, with Greater Cairo and the North Coast leading activity.
why: Aggregate property sales data serves as a vital barometer for domestic liquidity, consumer investment trends, and the financial health of Egyptian real estate developers.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Robust property sales exceeding one trillion pounds demonstrate strong domestic demand.
